reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that provides persistent local diary memory through per-turn context injection, note-taking, and recall tools.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体提供基于本地 Markdown 日记的持久记忆、逐轮上下文注入、记录和召回功能。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness agents with persistent local Markdown diary memory, per-turn context injection, note-taking, and recall tools.

capabilities: Reads diary entries from a configured local memory directory
Appends user- or agent-provided notes to local Markdown diary files
Injects recent diary content into the agent context each turn
Provides diary search through a brain_recall tool
